Connection to your GARDENA smart Gateway: Connection to your GARDENA smart Gateway
howto_text: Before the first start: open the web page of your gateway in the browser (enter its IP address), log in, open "Advanced settings" and switch on "Local API". Then enter the address and the password of the gateway below. The GARDENA app keeps working as before.
host_help: IP address of the gateway, e.g. 192.168.1.50 (you find it in your router)
password_help: Same password as for the web page of the gateway
raw_help: Additionally creates all values the gateway reports (folder "raw"). Only needed for troubleshooting.
support_text: The adapter is free. If it is useful to you, you can support its development voluntarily.
